name: Burn formation
explainer: Spathodea, Isolde, Lopera, and Ulu form a draft lineup focused on Burn.
howItWorks: This lineup brings together characters tagged for Burn and related support.

name: Bloodtithe formation
explainer: Nautika, Semmelweis, Sentinel, and Rubuska form the recommended Bloodtithe core.
howItWorks: Build around Nautika's damage, Semmelweis as the Bloodtithe battery and buffer, Sentinel's amplification, and a sustain slot.
notes: Sentinel is difficult to replace as a dedicated amplifier; Flutterpage is a common high-value alternative.
Semmelweis is a central part of this Bloodtithe plan.

name: Lingering Glow formation
explainer: Beryl, Isolde, Lorentz Butterfly, and Marsha make up the preferred Lingering Glow lineup.
howItWorks: Beryl leads the damage while Isolde enables Burn and Lorentz Butterfly adds flexible support; Marsha fills the sustain slot.
notes: Isolde is the key engine for consistency.
Flutterpage is a strong Lorentz Butterfly substitute when investing in Beryl.

name: Dynamo formation
explainer: Brume, Charon, Ulrich, and Enigma form one Dynamo core; Lucy, Corvus, and Recoleta can lead alternate carry variants.
howItWorks: Use Brume as the carry, Charon as the Dynamo engine, and fill the remaining slots with support and sustain.
notes: Charon is difficult to replace; teams without him may lose some of the intended Dynamo flow.
Wheelchair-style lineups can use Lucy, Corvus, or Recoleta as the carry with Charon and supports.

name: Conduit formation
explainer: The Twins or Coppélia lead a Conduit lineup supported by Everecho, Rhiannon, and Hedone.
howItWorks: The Twins lead the damage, Everecho supplies dedicated Conduit sustain, and Rhiannon or Hedone provide flexible support.
notes: Everecho is the dedicated Conduit sustain option in this guide.
If The Twins are unavailable, Coppélia can lead with Rhiannon or Hedone and Everecho.

name: Impromptu formation
explainer: Paper Heron, Liang Yue, or Barcarola can anchor an Impromptu lineup with Flutterpage and sustain.
howItWorks: Pair an Impromptu carry with an enabler, a follow-up attack buffer, and a sustain option.

name: Poison formation
explainer: Ramona, Willow, or Tuesday can anchor a Poison lineup alongside Jessica and a sustain option.
howItWorks: Choose a Poison-focused main damage dealer, add Jessica, and use the final slot for sustain or another Poison partner.

name: Follow-up / Extra Action formation
explainer: Flutterpage supports a high follow-up attack carry, with flexible buffer and sustain slots.
howItWorks: Build around Flutterpage and a high follow-up attack carry, then choose a buffer and sustain that fit the encounter.
notes: Flutterpage is difficult to replace as a dedicated follow-up attack enabler.

name: Ultimate / Ritual formation
explainer: Recoleta, Igor, or Spathodea can lead a lineup with an Ultimate support, buffer, and sustain.
howItWorks: Pair the chosen damage dealer with a specialist Ultimate support and complete the team with a buffer and sustain.

name: Riposte / Counter formation
explainer: Cornerstone and J form the counter-focused core, with a buffer and extra sustain.
howItWorks: Use Cornerstone as the main damage dealer and J as a Riposte partner, with flexible buffer and sustain slots.
